funfair.theme: a classic British travelling funfair cricket ground on a sunny afternoon
funfair.far: a giant Ferris wheel, a gold-and-red carousel with prancing horses and a spinning waltzer, all glowing with bulbs under a blue sky
funfair.sides: coconut shies, hook-a-duck stalls, candy-floss and toffee-apple stands, dodgems and strings of coloured bulbs
funfair.crowd: chunky families with candy floss, balloons and goldfish in bags, kids on shoulders

circus.theme: a cricket ring inside a huge red-and-white striped circus big top
circus.far: the ringmaster's podium and band stand under the striped canvas roof, trapeze artists swinging high up, gold poles and crossing spotlights, reaching up into the top of the tent
circus.sides: steep tiers of circus seats, clowns with squeaky horns, juggling clubs, unicycles and popcorn carts
circus.crowd: chunky circus-goers with popcorn and red noses, some in clown wigs
circus.ring: low red velvet ring curb with gold stars

themepark.surface: smooth bright aqua-blue rubber splash-pad surface
themepark.theme: a modern theme park cricket ground on a hot sunny day
themepark.far: giant looping rollercoasters, a log-flume splash with a big wave of spray, and a fairytale castle with pointed towers
themepark.sides: queue lines with bright railings, souvenir kiosks, a spinning teacup ride and palm trees
themepark.crowd: chunky theme-park fans in propeller caps and ponchos holding big swirl lollipops

fright.theme: a fright-night funfair cricket ground at midnight
fright.far: a haunted ghost-train ride with a giant grinning skull entrance, a creepy big wheel lit in green, a crooked haunted house and a huge full moon
fright.sides: spooky freak-show tents, a fortune teller booth, glowing green lanterns and a hall of mirrors
fright.crowd: chunky fans in monster masks, devil horns and skeleton onesies, waving glow sticks
fright.light: cold moonlight from top-left plus glowing green and orange ride lights
